svg.title: Multi-frame recurrent propagation architecture diagram
svg.desc: Editable reconstruction of a five-panel technical figure. Base frames f01 through f05 bound panels (a) to (d) and legend. Content is built with native SVG: feature cubes, buffers, recurrent blocks, arrows, braces, and labels.

g.desc: Panel (a) contains the origin volume, coordinate axes, divide arrow, time axis, five frame columns, feature extraction blocks, two feature buffers, recurrent propagation blocks, upsample blocks, propagation arrows and final image labels. Columns are arranged symmetrically along the horizontal time axis.
Panel (b) shows first-layer recurrent propagation. Origin is RP-I near the lower right, driven by current feature Yi and Fi, with dashed red links from K preceding features and dashed blue feedback.
Panel (c) shows second-layer recurrent propagation with 2K preceding modulation features, RP-II, current Fi and output Mi. The composition mirrors panel (b) with orange-coded memory features.

Panel (d) contains MFCA and CMF modules. K preceding features are represented by three slanted feature slabs feeding MFCA; MFCA outputs aligned features to CMF together with Yi, and CMF produces Fi. The panel is balanced horizontally with a dashed explanatory legend at the right.
Legend explains FE, upsample, RP-I/RP-II, propagation direction and two horizontal feature buffers.
